# Roy Okola Otieno — Portfolio

## Who is this site about?
Roy Okola Otieno is a clean energy and e-mobility engineer based in Nairobi, Kenya.
Technical Operations Engineer at Roam Electric. Founder of SafariCharge.

## What does this site contain?
- Projects: solar PV microgrids, EV charging hubs, AI engineering tools, clean energy SaaS products
- Resume: work history, education, certifications, and technical skills
- Blog: articles on clean energy, EV infrastructure, and sustainable engineering in East Africa
